reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonBusinessDay predicate that getNextDate and getDateWithSkippedWeekend already share, but leaves getDatesInRange's own inline holiday check (server/schedules/app.ts) as it was instead of routing it through the shared predicate.

duplication.why: The diff adds no new copy, but it does not remove the pre-existing inline `config.holidays?.includes(dayFromDate(date))` copy in getDatesInRange, which now disagrees with the shared rule.

placement.why: The holiday matching lives in shared/schedules.ts in the predicate that already owns the non-business-day decision.

scope.why: A three-line change to the predicate plus one focused test.

maintainability.why: Small and readable, but the holiday rule still exists in two places, so daily schedules listed through getDatesInRange ignore MM-DD holidays and the next rule change has to find the copy again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The diff itself goes through isNonBusinessDay; the bypassing copy in server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange predates it and was left untouched.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic duplicated by the diff.
